import google.cloud.storage
from mozilla_nimbus_schemas.jetstream import Metadata


def load_metadata_from_gcs(path):
    """Load Jetstream metadata through the sanctioned GCS path (new code)."""
    client = google.cloud.storage.Client()
    blob = client.bucket("analysis").blob(path)
    return Metadata.model_validate_json(blob.download_as_bytes())

from django.shortcuts import render
from django.views.generic import TemplateView

from experimenter.experiments.models import NimbusExperiment


class ExperimentSummaryView(TemplateView):
    """Server-rendered experiment summary page, no GraphQL (new code)."""

    template_name = "nimbus_ui/experiment_summary.html"

    def get_context_data(self, **kwargs):
        context = super().get_context_data(**kwargs)
        context["experiment"] = NimbusExperiment.objects.get(slug=kwargs["slug"])
        return context


def summary_fragment(request, slug):
    """HTMX fragment endpoint returning a partial render (new code)."""
    experiment = NimbusExperiment.objects.get(slug=slug)
    return render(request, "nimbus_ui/fragments/summary.html", {"experiment": experiment})

import google.cloud.storage
from mozilla_nimbus_schemas.jetstream import Statistics
from experimenter.experiments.models import NimbusExperiment


def refresh_results_data(experiment_id):
    """Re-fetch analysis data from GCS and refresh the stored results (new code)."""
    client = google.cloud.storage.Client()
    raw = client.bucket("analysis").blob(f"statistics_{experiment_id}.json").download_as_bytes()
    Statistics.model_validate_json(raw)
    NimbusExperiment.objects.filter(id=experiment_id).update(results_data={"v3": {}})
    return True
